title: iOS Safari zooms the page when a 14px text box is focused
acceptance: Text inputs, search boxes, selects and textareas render at 16px or larger below the sm breakpoint, so iOS Safari does not zoom on focus; desktop sizes are unchanged.
The viewport meta keeps user zoom enabled (no maximum-scale or user-scalable=no).
A check (lint rule, test or grep in CI) flags a new form field below 16px on mobile.
nextAction: Owner: against production (deployed 2026-11-05, main ddd4b70), on iPhone Safari tap Music › Songs Search songs, the Create a class name field and the sign-in Email field; the page must not zoom. Then set Done.

evidence.summary: Owner's iPhone Safari run of RF-151 on production af800c8, 2026-11-03: tapping Search songs, then the Create a class name field, zoomed the page about 1.15x and it stayed zoomed (right and left edges cut off), which looked like horizontal overflow. The Mac run at 1440 wide had no overflow (scrollWidth 1425).
Search songs and the catalog search inputs use text-sm (14px); iOS Safari zooms on focus below 16px.
The Create a class name input (song-pick-class-title) uses text-sm (14px).
#717 final review finding 6: no shared input class; the zoomed field is in SongPicks.tsx; corrected here.
Owner set RF-189 Ready for the Neo on 2026-11-04 ("Yes approved", quoted in this PR body); this draft PR is the Neo claim.

Substitution flagged: one phone-only rule (below 640px) sets every text-entry input, select and textarea to 16px !important, instead of editing about 80 fields to text-base sm:text-sm. It covers fields added later too; desktop sizes are unchanged. The viewport meta in apps/web/index.html is unchanged (no maximum-scale, no user-scalable=no).

expectNoZoomingFields fails the phone-390 smoke for any visible text field under 16px (sign-up form, Music search, Create a class sheet, and every checkPage destination). Without the CSS rule it fails on login-name and login-email at 14px; with it both projects pass.

Deployed to production on 2026-11-05 from the Air: main ddd4b70, Worker 4c906295-6506-4bc5-b886-8f568446c527, SPA assets/index-CzpTnNZB.js, rollback 229cf040-3b4e-48ac-80bd-10573d017810 (bd2b8fa). Smoke and security headers passed. The owner's iPhone Safari check is still owed.
